title: Fifth amendment: coherent state latch (Defect A) and real-time injected scenario proof (Defect B)
frozen_before: any reevaluation or actual-002 measurement under the corrected harness

supersedes.note: Additive. The actual-full-001 raw artifacts are preserved byte-for-byte and are never rewritten. Original predeclared.json, protocol.sha256, amendments 1-4, all contracts and receipts are preserved.

reason: The first actual full measurement (actual-full-001) exposed two harness defects: (A) all 54 cells reported state_end.prepared=false/sampleRate=0 because the final readJamLiveState result was used even when the coherent latest-value read returned false (no new publication / sequence race); (B) the injected scenario ran unpaced so the analysis/control workers could not keep the timeline and never joined, making the join proof vacuous.

A_coherent_state_latch.defect: runCell used the result of readJamLiveState(c.stateEnd) even when it returned false; the coherent latest-value slot returns false when there is no new publication, leaving a default zero state.
A_coherent_state_latch.correction: Obtain a baseline prepared state (prepared=true, sampleRate>0) with a bounded off-callback poll BEFORE the cold callback, and initialize state_start and state_end from it. Update state_end ONLY when a read returns true; never reset it on false. The final read is a temp that replaces state_end only on true. The reported state_end is the last coherent snapshot, not an exact current-callback cursor, and retains the seen generation/prepared/rate. No unbounded wait or forced worker.
A_coherent_state_latch.test: A pure StateLatch helper (shared by the harness and the support self-test) retains the last valid prepared/rate/cursor on false and fails explicitly if no baseline was ever read.

B_injected_realtime_proof.defect: runInjectedJoinStop had no sleep; 8 s of audio ran in milliseconds, so the workers could not track the timeline, the ring overflowed, and no join occurred. StopNow 'passed' at block 1 without a join; resync accepted without servicing; the reprepare generations were not a real session-generation change.
B_injected_realtime_proof.correction: Pace the injected scenario in real time (block/rate steady_clock.sleep_until outside the callback). Require a first join (engine injectedPlaying + steps grow) within a bounded 8 s audio window, a deferred StopAtNextBar that actually persists until the bar, a SECOND actual join before StopNow, an actual StopNow measured in serviced blocks after the command, an actual resync effect observation, session-generation change via prepare cold state, and a coherent released payload (prepared=false, drumsPlaying=false) on shutdown. Command acceptance alone is never treated as proof.
B_injected_realtime_proof.gate: The injected join gate now requires firstJoin and secondJoin, steps_fired>0, engine_playing_observed, stop_now_stopped, resync_accepted AND resync_effect_observed, session_generation_changed and released_confirmed. No output-RMS-only claim: engine steps and injected playing carry the proof.

semantics_unchanged: structural AND rt_gate AND join_gate; default no-lock remains diagnostic; the 54-cell matrix, pacing, warm counts and expected ids are unchanged. Only the injected scenario is strengthened to prove what the gate already claimed.

preserve.note: A truthful actual-002 run in a different directory is required; failures are never hidden by editing evidence.
